column7: A per-IP auth budget (login, password_reset, sso_begin) whose COUNT query fails while its inserts succeed still binds at its fallback limit: successful writes made while degraded are mirrored in memory and a failed count is judged on memory including mirrors (working counts ignore mirrors: TestAuthBudget_CountOnlyFailure_RecoveryDoesNotDoubleCount). Red on #3032 @ fdea9f65: 100 of 100 attempts allowed for every budget. #3032 review (MERGE-MASTER finding 1).
